aspects.name: description
attributes: Search FB Marketplace, monitor deals

aspects.name: usefulness
attributes: 🛒 If you use it

aspects.name: components
attributes: Includes fbm.py (search listings with filters)
Includes monitor.py (watch deals and learn preferences)
Includes fb_chat.py (Messenger inbox and seller chat)
Includes fb_login.py (auto-login via Facebook mobile API)
Includes fb_login_interactive.py (browser-based CAPTCHA solving)

aspects.name: installation_path
attributes: Installed at /workspace/skills/fb-marketplace/scripts

aspects.name: authentication_methods
attributes: Quick method: python3 fbm.py set-cookies '<cookie string>'
Full login: python3 fb_login.py --set-creds EMAIL PASSWORD

aspects.name: commands
attributes: Start tracking a search with `fb-marketplace watch add "<query>" --max <num>`
List active searches with `fb-marketplace watch list`
Check new deals across all watches using `fb-marketplace scan`
Train preferences for a specific watch with `fb-marketplace learn <id> "<description>"`

aspects.name: monitoring_status
attributes: Initial scan in progress
Active watch for coffee tables

aspects.name: notification_method
attributes: Telegram integration configured for listings

aspects.name: capabilities
attributes: Tracks seen listings in 'seen.json' to prevent duplicates
Includes thumbnail image URLs for each listing
Provides direct marketplace links for each post
Can download and forward images as file attachments

aspects.name: limitations
attributes: No built-in vision model for image analysis
Requires manual setup for Telegram notifications
